name: sprite_builder_create_project
description: Create a project for a GitHub repo. Requires name and repo_full_name (owner/repo, must be reachable by the key owner's GitHub token). Optional: default_branch (default main), dockerfile_path (default Dockerfile), container_port (default 8080, the port the container listens on), repo_id (GitHub numeric id). Returns the new project with its id.

default_branch.description: Branch whose HEAD builds when no commit is given. Default 'main'.

dockerfile_path.description: Path to the Dockerfile within the repo. Default 'Dockerfile'.

container_port.description: Port the built container listens on; mapped to the public URL. Default 8080.
